begin_of_turn_query.content: I need to schedule a flight soon on booking id 1234 and want to examine different alternatives. Calculate the cost of a business class ticket for the first airport on the available list to the last airport on the same list, on the last day of October 2026. Provide the estimated total payable amount for me.
